GetValue may be delayed by an ongoing call from another thread to RemoveAllKeys or Discard PendingChanges, or to SetValue, RemoveKey, RecoverKey, or ResetKey for the same key-value pair. This method uses transaction semantics, it sees the current state of transaction, not the actual physical storage.
